Sally was looking at the pretty butterfly in a bush. She watched it carefully. But then, she noticed something strange. lots of the collects in one of the bush were singing to her. Sally thought it was so funny. 

Sally kept wandering and becoming more crazy. To her surprise, she found herself in a field filled with funny, funny noises. Her friends laughed and smiled at her.
